The case does not require a positive production unknown-outcome lookup or resolution transition. A durable adapter-proven known-no-effect retry_wait replay within the already-declared retry policy provides a bounded supported positive path, while unresolved unknown must refuse.

Pinned provider exposes only POST. Production lookup or unknown same-key replay remains unsupported without a separately pinned reviewed successor. No status lookup, fabricated receipt or unknown reset may be introduced by this proposal.

Native host already owns privileged service credential issue/revoke, explicitly excluded from authored routes/callables. A separate opaque native operator grant at that existing host trust boundary needs no new application role/grammar/callback or worker authority elevation.

Generated initialization clears/invalidate old host before configuration load, including failure.
